maddeler.e:
تختصروا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَصِرُوا (taḵtaṣirū) /tax.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# تُخْتَصَرُوا (tuḵtaṣarū) /tux.ta.sˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
